o.text: From köy (“village”) + -lü. The sense “Minecraft villager” is from Turkish köylü.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آتلو (atlu). By surface analysis, at + -lı
From Persian پررنگ (porrang), from پر (por, “full”) + رنگ (rang, “colour”). Equivalent to Azerbaijani pür + rəng.
Borrowed from Turkish ödül, from Mongolian [Term?].
From duy- (“to feel; to become aware of”) + -uq.
